newsitem.title: UK: Shield signs development deal with Abbott.
newsitem.headline: Shield signs development deal with Abbott.

text.p: Britain's Shield Diagnostics Group Plc said on Wednesday it had signed a five-year agreement with diagnostics giant Abbott Laboratories to develop products for use on Abbott instruments.
The accord firms up a provisional agreement announced in January, and will strengthen speculation that Abbott could emerge as a partner for Shield's AFT test for heart disease.
Shares in Shield initially rose sharply on the news, touching a high of 613 pence before slipping back to trade down 2-1/2 pence at 565.
Shield said the initial work would be on tests for an infection known as Lyme disease, "with opportunities to add other programmes in the future."
